item.title: Hong Kong customs seizes 200 crickets, 13kg of cockroaches at border checkpoint
item.description: Hong Kong customs officers have intercepted two travellers in separate cases at the Lo Wu border checkpoint for allegedly importing live insects commonly used as reptile feed. On Saturday, officers stopped a 71-year-old local man at the arrival hall and seized 200 crickets from his baggage, valued at about HK$2,000 (US$255). The following day, officers intercepted a 66-year-old local woman at the same checkpoint carrying 13kg (28.6lbs) of dubia roaches, worth about HK$3,900, in her baggage. Both... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Inside a $25 million Florida mansion with AI controls and 150 feet of Boca Raton waterfront
item.description: An exquisite mansion in Boca Raton exemplifies the pinnacle of luxury living through cutting-edge AI integration. This stunning waterfront property marries sleek modern design with comprehensive smart-home technology, allowing residents to seamlessly control lighting, audio, and climate via voice commands. With six spacious bedrooms and a resort-style outdoor entertainment area, this home is a testament to the transformative power of technology in the luxury real estate market. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Mum of five repeatedly begged for medication in custody, inquest hears
item.description: A First Nations mother of five repeatedly begged prison officials for her medications and was discharged from hospital after a suicide attempt without a mental health review, a coronial inquest heard today. item.title: Meet Benjamin Choi, 17-year-old who built a $300 mind-controlled prosthetic arm that reads brainwaves through non-invasive electrodes
item.description: Benjamin Choi developed an accessible prosthetic arm during the pandemic. This device interprets brain waves and head gestures for control. His invention significantly reduces the cost of advanced prosthetic limbs. Choi's work earned him recognition and funding for further research. He continues to advance machine learning applications in his career. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
